paragraphs: Mar Yanuka and Mar Kashisha, Rav Ḥisda's sons (see his entry). Tosafot, Bava Batra 7b, says Mar Yanuka is placed first because he was born in Rav Ḥisda's youth, and Mar Kashisha in his old age. Mar Kashisha spoke to Abaye, Menaḥot 109b; to Rav Ashi, Shabbat 114b, Bava Kamma 96b, Ta'anit 28a, Yevamot 115b. They told Rav Ashi, 'Once Amemar visited our place,' Arvei Pesaḥim 107a. Mar Kashisha son of Rav Ḥisda said to Rav Ashi, etc. Rav Assi said to Rav Ashi, Sukkah 8a. It requires examination whether this was the early Rav Ashi, who lived in Rav Assi's days, and Mar Kashisha spoke to that early Rav Ashi. How then could he say Amemar visited their place, since Amemar lived in the later Rav Ashi's time? See below, Mar son of Rav Ashi, and what I wrote there. He told Rav Ashi, 'Thus we say in R. Yoḥanan's name,' Gittin 87a. Amemar was Mar Yanuka's son.
